what: Claude Code billing switch commands: `claude config set --global apiProvider anthropic-console` to use Console API credits (pay-per-token). `claude login --api-key` + paste key from console.anthropic.com/settings/keys. To switch back to Pro/Max subscription: `claude login` (regular login). Fast mode on Console is 6x standard Opus pricing (~$30/150 per MTok). User has existing Console credits available.
why: User wants to reference these commands later for switching between subscription and API billing.
